item.title: The extraordinary joy of Ethel Kennedy
item.description: In her new book, "Ethel Kennedy: The Extraordinary Life and Bold Legacy," daughter Kerry Kennedy writes about a woman who maintained positivity and resilience despite public and private tragedies. Kennedy talks with correspondent Rita Braver about her mother's marriage to Senator Robert F. Kennedy, and how she forged ahead following his assassination. She also discusses the dichotomy of Ethel's relationship with her son, Robert F. Kennedy Jr.

item.title: Houthis issue new threat on Saudi airspace after attack on Riyadh airport
item.description: The strike on King Khalid International Airport, the deadliest on Saudi soil in more than a decade, marked a major escalation in the war between Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis and the kingdom.

item.title: After airport strike, Trump considering whether to join fight against Houthis
item.description: Following the latest strike Saturday on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport, President Trump said the U.S. "may" join the fight against the Iran-backed Houthis.

item.title: Pope Leo to undergo surgery after nodular lesion found in lung, Vatican says
item.description: The American pope has no previously known health problems and is known to be physically active

item.title: India's "Cockroach Party" leaders released from detention
item.description: Three leaders of India's Cockroach Janata Party, a youth movement, were released Sunday, a day after they were detained ahead of protests against a contentious revision of voter lists.

item.title: At least 12 killed, more than 300 hurt in strike on Saudi airport, officials say
item.description: At least 12 people, including one American, were killed and 309 others injured in a strike Saturday​ on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport.

item.title: Hurricane Simon strengthens into Category 4 storm as it takes aim at Mexico
item.description: Simon has strengthened into a powerful Category 4 hurricane as it barrels toward Mexico's Pacific coast.

item.description: Hundreds of thousands of customers were without power after Isaias made landfall as a hurricane on the northern Gulf Coast.

item.title: Chicago White Sox fan Pope Leo on his favorite team making the playoffs
item.description: Chicago White Sox superfan Pope Leo was asked if he had anything to do with their playoff "miracle" as the team prepares to face Cleveland on Saturday night. Chris Livesay has the story from Rome.

item.title: DOJ investigating TV networks over suspension of press pool after Trump media ban
item.description: The Justice Department is investigating whether the major TV networks violated antitrust laws after they briefly suspended the TV press pool system in response to President Trump's decision to ban three news organizations from the White House.

item.title: Trump says Ukraine needs new president, blames Zelenskyy for diesel prices
item.description: President Trump's criticism of Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy comes after Russian strikes killed at least 20 people, including three children, in Ukraine.

item.title: At least 12 killed, over 300 injured after strike on Riyadh airport, Saudi officials say
item.description: At least 12 people were killed, and over 300 were injured after a strike at Riyadh's international airport in Saudi Arabia, officials said.

item.title: Hollywood economy suffering as film jobs lost, production money moved out of state
item.description: The entertainment economy in Hollywood is struggling as studios lose jobs to industry consolidation and film producers look outside California. Akiko Fujita has more.

item.title: Federal judge halts government from deporting man shot by ICE in NYC
item.description: A federal judge in New York has ruled to stop the government from deporting a man shot by ICE agents amid widespread protests. Ali Bauman reports.

item.title: Ukraine says it won't stop attacking Russian oil resources amid diesel fuel deal with U.S.
item.description: President Trump is arguing that Ukraine needs a new president as Volodymyr Zelenskyy refuses to halt strikes on Russian oil refineries despite the country's commitment to provide diesel fuel to the U.S. Kamal Afzali has the story.

item.title: Trump hits campaign trail in Tennessee with midterms voting less than 3 weeks away
item.description: President Trump campaigned for Republican candidates in Tennessee on Saturday as the GOP faces a rough forecast with midterms less than three weeks away. Taurean Small has more.

item.title: Hundreds of thousands without power as Isaias makes landfall, kills at least 4
item.description: Hundreds of thousands of people are without power and dealing with debris cleanup after Isaias made landfall as a Category 2 Hurricane on Friday night. Jason Allen reports, and Grant Gilmore has the forecast.

item.title: This week on "Sunday Morning" (Oct. 11)
item.description: A look at the features for this week's broadcast of the Emmy-winning program, hosted by Jane Pauley.

item.title: Watch: Shocking videos show the moment Hurricane Isaias hit the Gulf Coast
item.description: Isaias hit the Gulf Coast as a Category 2 storm on Friday night, leaving behind debris, cutting off power to hundreds of thousands, and killing at least 4 across Florida and Alabama. Videos show the moment it made landfall.

item.title: Gunman charged with killing officer, wounding another in West Philly
item.description: Eric Lewis faces several charges, including homicide of a law enforcement officer, in the shooting death of 40-year-old Shane Seiber.

item.title: 8 killed, including 2 children, in mass shooting in Erie; suspect also dead
item.description: Eight people, including two children, were killed Friday in a mass shooting in a residential area of Erie, Pennsylvania, authorities said. The suspected gunman is also dead.

item.description: "I am confident that Katie will deliver strong results for our Country as the next White House Press Secretary," President Trump said.

item.title: Mike Ditka, former Chicago Bears head coach, dies at 86
item.description: Raised in a blue-collar Pennsylvania town, Mike Ditka earned a scholarship to Pitt and became "Da Coach" in Chicago. His family called him "the heart of our family" in announcing his death at 86.

item.title: Nobel Peace Prize awarded to former ICC judge Navi Pillay
item.description: Nobel Peace Prize 2026 was awarded to Navanethem "Navi" Pillay, a former judge on the International Criminal Court, drawing a quick, angry rebuke from Israel.

item.title: Trump promises not to resume Iran strikes before midterm elections
item.description: Crude oil prices had shot up on Thursday after reports President Trump was considering more strikes. They immediately dropped again after his new announcement.
